title: Bounded-above flat complexes are K-flat at independent universes
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a site essentially small in a coefficient universe $w$, let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings in universe $w$, and let $P$ be a cochain complex of sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If $P^i=0$ for $i>n$ for some integer $n$, and each $P^i$ is flat for the sheafified sectionwise tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], then $P$ is K-flat: the direct-sum total tensor complex of every acyclic complex with $P$ is acyclic [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Site object and morphism universes may differ independently from $w$.

proof.text: The sheafification counit and its monoidal tensor comparison identify siteSheafTensorRight M with tensorRight M. The braiding identifies tensorRight M with tensorLeft M. Hence site-flat terms are flat in the categorical sense. Tensor-colimit preservation [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits] gives tensor additivity, monoidal preadditivity, and the graded tensor associativity instances.

Filtered colimits of abelian groups are exact, also after shrinking from universe w to universe 0. Transfer exact sequential colimits to sheaf modules using HasExactColimitsOfShape.domain_of_functor and the forgetful functor to abelian sheaves. This uses the proved source-library module-sheaf colimit-preservation instance, not a Grothendieck-generator construction.

Apply CochainComplex.kFlat_of_isStrictlyLE_of_flat in lean/WeilConjectures/FromJoel/CategoryTheory/Abelian/Flat/KFlat.lean, lines 338-353. Its proof writes P as the filtered colimit of its finite flat stupid truncations, so total tensoring with P preserves quasi-isomorphisms. All its monoidal and exact-colimit hypotheses have been supplied above.

For an arbitrary acyclic complex Z, the zero map from the zero complex to Z is a quasi-isomorphism. Tensoring it with P is therefore a quasi-isomorphism. Its source is zero because tensoring is additive. Vanishing homology of its target is precisely the required total-tensor acyclicity.

note: This is the independent-universe form of lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat-site. Its existing Lean theorem requires site and coefficient universes to coincide and legacy IsFlat; it cannot be applied to the arbitrary universes of the consumer. The proof reuses the proved generic source-library bounded-flat theorem rather than duplicating the spectral-sequence argument.
